heat_formula: heat = 10*ln(1+E) + 8*ln(1+N) + 3*log10(1+S) + 2*log10(1+I); E = likes + 2*reposts + 3*quotes + replies + bookmarks summed over the year sample of X posts for the skill (full-archive search 2025-11-12 → 2026-11-12, top 25 by relevancy, retweets excluded); N = posts in that sample (max 25); S = GitHub stars (0 if unknown); I = skills.sh total installs for the repo (0 if unknown, and 0 if flagged suspicious: installs > 1000 x stars). Industry heat = sum of its skills' heat; industries and skills ranked by heat.

heat_formula_l10n.en: heat = 10*ln(1+E) + 8*ln(1+N) + 3*log10(1+S) + 2*log10(1+I); E = likes + 2*reposts + 3*quotes + replies + bookmarks summed over the year sample of X posts for the skill (full-archive search 2025-11-12 → 2026-11-12, top 25 by relevancy, retweets excluded); N = posts in that sample (max 25); S = GitHub stars (0 if unknown); I = skills.sh total installs for the repo (0 if unknown, and 0 if flagged suspicious: installs > 1000 x stars). Industry heat = sum of its skills' heat; industries and skills ranked by heat.
heat_formula_l10n.zh: 热度 = 10·ln(1+E) + 8·ln(1+N) + 3·log10(1+S) + 2·log10(1+I)；E = 该技能年度 X 样本帖子的 点赞 + 2×转发 + 3×引用 + 回复 + 收藏 之和（全量归档搜索 2025-11-12 → 2026-11-12，按相关度取前 25 条，不含转推）；N = 样本帖子数（最多 25）；S = GitHub 星标（未知记 0）；I = skills.sh 仓库总安装量（未知记 0；安装量 > 1000×星标 视为可疑，记 0 不计入热度）。行业热度 = 行业内技能热度之和；行业与技能均按热度排序。
heat_formula_l10n.fr: chaleur = 10·ln(1+E) + 8·ln(1+N) + 3·log10(1+S) + 2·log10(1+I) ; E = j'aime + 2×reposts + 3×citations + réponses + signets, sommés sur l'échantillon annuel de posts X du skill (recherche archive complète 2025-11-12 → 2026-11-12, 25 premiers par pertinence, sans retweets) ; N = posts de l'échantillon (max 25) ; S = étoiles GitHub (0 si inconnu) ; I = installations totales skills.sh du dépôt (0 si inconnu ou signalé suspect : installations > 1000 × étoiles). heat_formula_l10n.es: calor = 10·ln(1+E) + 8·ln(1+N) + 3·log10(1+S) + 2·log10(1+I); E = me gusta + 2×reposts + 3×citas + respuestas + guardados, sumados sobre la muestra anual de posts de X del skill (búsqueda en archivo completo 2025-11-12 → 2026-11-12, 25 primeros por relevancia, sin retuits); N = posts de la muestra (máx. 25); S = estrellas de GitHub (0 si se desconoce); I = instalaciones totales en skills.sh del repo (0 si se desconoce o si es sospechoso: instalaciones > 1000 × estrellas).
